title: Ground slam
subtitle: Design a clear signal, a reachable response, and a useful opening.
summary: The boss strikes the floor and sends a readable shockwave outward from the impact point.
overview: A ground slam turns one impact into an expanding area threat. It works when the center and growth rate are visible, a valid route exists, and the impact timing tests a skill already taught.
learning: Tune the signal, the impact center and wave edge, response time, and recovery.

demo.title: Test the pattern
phaseDescriptions: The boss raises its weight and marks the future impact point.
The strike lands and fixes the center of the threat.
A ring expands across the floor while the player reaches clear space.
demo.reducedMotion: Autoplay is disabled by the reduced-motion setting. Use the timeline slider to inspect the loop.
demo.diagramDescription: A looping diagram of ground slam. The boss signals the pattern, the player responds, and both return smoothly to their starting positions.

steps.title: Is the signal specific?
steps.body: Make the lift, impact point, and exact contact frame distinct from ordinary movement.

steps.title: Is the response reachable?
steps.body: Compare wave speed with running, jumping, dodging, and the arena boundary.

steps.title: Is the opening useful?
steps.body: Give the slam enough recovery for the successful response to change the fight.

mistakes.title: Hidden rule
mistakes.body: If the signal does not reveal the impact center and wave edge, the hit feels arbitrary.

mistakes.title: Wrong scale
mistakes.body: If timing is tested only at one upgrade level, the pattern can become trivial or unavoidable.

designNotes.title: Match visuals and collision
designNotes.body: The visible threat must match the active hitbox in space and time.

designNotes.title: Start with ordinary abilities
designNotes.body: Keep one response available with abilities the player already has.

designNotes.title: Retest upgrades
designNotes.body: Check movement, range, damage, and invulnerability against every phase.

story.title: Make the arena support the rule
story.body: Keep the floor and wave edge visible; slopes and decoration must not mask timing.

adaptation.title: Respect player upgrades
adaptation.body: Test the strongest available build. If an attack is blocked, make the immunity clear and preserve another useful response.

distinction.title: Name the exact pattern
distinction.body: A slam is the impact; the shockwave is the expanding threat it may create.

lensNotes.body: The cue reveals what will happen, where, and when.
The shape of danger defines the player’s possible routes.
A readable response turns pressure into a decision.
The pattern tests skills taught before this encounter.

examples.body: The hammer impact produces a floor wave whose edge and travel time can be read in a side view.
Repeated stomps project pressure through a 3D arena and test the jump timing taught by the game.
The axe strike sends out consecutive circular shockwaves. Staggering the rings extends one impact through time as well as across the arena.
